description: Business must have been operating for at least 2 years
Annual business turnover must be at least Rs. 12 lakh
Applicant CIBIL credit score must be 700 or higher
Applicant age must be between 23 and 65 years at loan maturity
Requested loan amount must be between Rs. 1 lakh and Rs. 50 lakh
No loan default or 90+ days past due in the last 12 months
Business must be registered (GST or Udyam or shop and establishment licence)
